rca.defect: The replay-aware OTLP cardinality gate required an idempotent replay record for the non-replay causal qualification profile and rejected its otherwise exact one-controller/one-inference span contract.
rca.remediation: Keep the strict unique-plus-one controller rule for accepted success profiles that declare the frozen replay, while deriving equal controller and inference counts from the unique request set when the qualification contract contains no replay field.
